about: MOCK faucet answers for tests: what Hyperliquid testnet's /info might send back to {"type": "claimDrip", "user": ...}. Only no_mainnet_deposit came from the live faucet. The rest follow the testnet app's own handling (assets/Drip-*.js and its request helper) or are guesses, as each source says.

cases.name: claimed
cases.source: MOCK. The testnet app's Drip page shows 'Drip confirmed.' when the answer is null. Not seen live: that needs an address with a mainnet deposit.

cases.name: no_mainnet_deposit
cases.body: "Cannot claim drip because user 0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000aa does not exist on mainnet."
cases.source: Seen live on 2026-11-09 for a random, never-funded address (the address here is a placeholder).

cases.name: already_claimed
cases.source: MOCK. The wording is a guess: Hyperliquid's real text is not public. Any refusal that says 'already' counts.

cases.name: rate_limited
cases.source: MOCK. The testnet app shows 'Rate limited' for HTTP 429.

cases.name: other_refusal
cases.source: MOCK. Any other string is a refusal in the faucet's own words, as the testnet app shows it.

cases.name: bad_request
cases.body: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type
cases.expect: refused:Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type

cases.name: server_error
cases.source: MOCK. A 5xx answer from a proxy.
